decisions.reason: Because this more adjacent offering supports the firm's strategic move toward future-oriented, interoperable solutions and the growing industry gives some slack, management would keep it unless its market results now fall clearly below aspiration levels.

As a close-to-core hydraulic spraying system that uses existing engineering and customer-process capabilities, it is likely to be kept while the firm gives it time to prove itself, though recent quick withdrawals of weaker launches keep some risk of discontinuation.
